title: 5x5 with at most 3 holes (any blocks): is 149 the longest?
description: Exhaustive backward search of every 5x5 level with at most 3 holes and any number of blocks, real rules (blocks may cross the exit). Each chunk is a contiguous range of the search in a fixed order; the union of all chunks is the whole search. Estimates are rough (some chunks will run much longer than shown).
